payload.summary: Add sign-off kinds with content pins for the Chief Psychiatrist Standards and the forms cultural notes
payload.detail: data/chief-psychiatrist-standards.json (8 drafted) and data/forms-cultural-notes.json (23 drafted) have no path through npm run clinical:review; today they could only be marked reviewed by hand-editing JSON, with no pin. Extend scripts/lib/clinical-record-review-contract.mjs with standard and cultural-note kinds, pin the rendered text, add --check enforcement and tests.
